description: Build an itemized countertop quote at ATX Granite King's posted rates (install $38/sq ft, $30/sq ft over 1,000 sq ft, Budget Collection slabs $999) from the user's sq ft or counter runs, island and options. Items with no posted price are listed as quoted at measure. Returns at once with a shareable quote page URL. If room_image_url (a public photo of the user's kitchen) is given, the stone is also rendered onto it (optionally with a cabinet_wood / hardware_finish from list_finishes) and the picture usually comes back in this reply. No public photo link? Give the user the quote_url: they can upload a kitchen photo there.

backsplash_height_in.description: Stone backsplash height in inches along the runs; 0 = none (default). Quoted at measure.

cabinet_wood.description: Visualization only (we don't sell cabinets). One of: keep, white-oak, red-oak, walnut, cherry, maple, hickory, painted-white, painted-navy, painted-greige, painted-sage. Default keep.

city.description: City of the job (same price within 60 miles of Austin)

edge.description: Edge profile; eased is standard, others quoted at measure

hardware_finish.description: Visualization only (we don't sell hardware). One of: keep, matte-black, brushed-nickel, brushed-brass, polished-chrome, oil-rubbed-bronze, unlacquered-brass. Default keep.

name.description: Optional name to show on the quote

room_image_url.description: Public URL of a photo of the kitchen, countertops visible

runs.description: Counter runs (up to 12): length_in, optional depth_in (default 25.5), optional label

sqft.description: Countertop square feet, if known. Otherwise give runs (and island).

stone_slug.description: Stone slug from search_stones, e.g. '2cm-taj-mahal-premium-leather' or 'budget-absolute-white'

tear_out.description: Tear-out of old tops (quoted at measure)

name: generate_quote
title: Itemized countertop quote (+ optional kitchen render)
